subject: Clinixia: EU-only processing, VPC peering & SIG evidence request
messages:
From: Sarah Müller <procurement@clinixia.de>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-02-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Clinixia RFI - EU-only processing, VPC peering, SIG/CAIQ

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking the initial call last week. Attached is our procurement/security RFI (Clinixia_Security_RFI.xlsx). High level asks we need to validate before we proceed to procurement: 
- Confirmation that production data for Clinixia can be processed and stored only in EU regions (no cross-border processing outside the EU).
- VPC peering or private connector option (no public internet egress for inference traffic).
- SOC 2/SIG/CAIQ evidence and a short summary of any unsupported controls.
- HSM/KMS support for tenant keys and custody model options.
- Current subprocessors list and commitment to notify changes.
- Data deletion/erasure SLA and DPA language for data subject requests.

We have a target timeline to complete this by 2028-02-15 so procurement can include the appropriate clauses in the PO. Can you confirm next steps and who will produce the evidence bundle?

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Müller
Head of Procurement, Clinixia GmbH
[attachment: Clinixia_Security_RFI.xlsx]
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Müller <procurement@clinixia.de>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-02-01T12:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Clinixia RFI - EU-only processing, VPC peering, SIG/CAIQ

Hi Sarah — thanks for the RFI and the clear checklist. We can take the lead on delivering a combined evidence pack and draft contractual language. 

Quick answers up front:
- EU-only processing: Yes — we can commit to processing and storing Clinixia production data only in EU regions. We support regional routing policies and can pin workloads to eu-west-1 and eu-central-1.
- VPC peering/private connector: Available; we offer Private (VPC) deployments with private control plane options and peering arrangements.
- HSM/KMS: Tenant key support available via customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key) and integrations with common HSM providers.
- SIG/CAIQ & SOC 2: We'll provide the latest SIG spreadsheet and a CAIQ summary; SOC 2 report will be provided under NDA.

Looping in Soojin from Security and Marissa from Legal to coordinate the evidence and suggest DPA language. We can schedule a short technical call this week to review peering topology and key custody. I've included a calendar link below.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
[jordan_blake@redwood.com]
https://cal.redwood.com/jordan/clinixia-technical-call
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-02-02T08:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Clinixia RFI - prep: SIG/CAIQ + VPC notes

Jordan / Marissa — draft inputs below, pulled together with engineering. I'll produce a cleaned evidence bundle for Clinixia once we align on the peering contact and the DPA ask.

SIG/CAIQ / SOC notes:
- Attached: redwood_sig_v4.xlsx (full SIG answers), redwood_caiq_summary.pdf (control highlights + gaps).
- SOC 2: Latest report is on file; we need NDA before sharing. Known gap: physical access controls for customer-managed on-prem connectors (not applicable for our hosted/eu private deployment). We'll call that out in an exceptions section.

VPC / network:
- VPC peering supported in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1. Private control plane is optional for Private customers; for Dedicated we can also provide private management endpoints.
- We recommend IP allowlist + mutual TLS for the peering connection. We provide a VPC peering playbook (vpc_peering_playbook.pdf) — includes routing tables, flow logs, and MTU recommendations.

KMS / HSM:
- Customer-managed KMS supported via AWS KMS imported keys or external HSMs via standard KMIP bridges. We can document key lifecycle and key rotation cadence.

Subprocessors / data flow:
- Current subprocessors list: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/clinixia/subprocessors_list.csv (includes cloud infra providers in eu and security vendors). We have a contractual obligation to notify changes within 30 days.

Data deletion / retention:
- Default data retention for model inputs is 30 days in hosted mode; for Dedicated/Private we can contract custom retention windows and an explicit data-erasure SLA (30 days to return+delete unless otherwise contracted).

I'll assemble these into a combined evidence bundle (redwood_sig_v4, caiaq, peering playbook, subprocessors list) and share a single ZIP for procurement.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood_sig_v4.xlsx]
[attachment: redwood_caiq_summary.pdf]
[attachment: vpc_peering_playbook.pdf]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-02-03T10:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Clinixia RFI - DPA language suggestion

Jordan / Soojin — quick legal input:
- For EU-only processing we should propose the following contract language in the DPA: 
  "Redwood Inference shall process and store Customer Personal Data only within the European Union, and shall not export such Personal Data outside the EU except as required by law. Redwood will ensure all subprocessors that receive or process Customer Personal Data are bound by equivalent data protection obligations."

- SCCs: We'll propose the EU SCCs (2021) as the transfer mechanism, and include the technical and organizational measures summary as an annex.
- Data deletion SLA: Recommend 30 days for deletion of application data upon termination, with a 60-day timeline for long-term backups.
- Audit / evidence: SOC 2 report provided under NDA; SIG/CAIQ and subprocessors list may be provided by Redwood without NDA.

Attaching a short doc with clause suggestions: DPA_clause_suggestion.docx. Once Soojin finalizes the evidence bundle, we can send to Clinixia with the proposed DPA language.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
